name: bug-verifier
description: Verify whether a reported bug is a real defect, then write an issue report a reviewer can act on and an understanding guide that teaches the module design behind it.

interface.shortDescription: Judge whether a reported bug is real, then document it.
interface.longDescription: Reads a bug document and the source tree it accuses, reads the named function and the triggering test, traces whether the bad state is reachable from a public entry point with caller-controlled input, and lands on one verdict: confirmed defect, latent defect, not a defect, or undetermined. For a real defect it writes two files: an issue report with exact file:line references, code snippets, reproduction, expected versus actual behavior, and fix options; and an understanding guide covering the module's role and design intent, the invariants it relies on, and the unfamiliar concepts a reader needs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the bug-verifier skill on this bug document and source directory: check whether it is a real defect, then write the issue report and the understanding guide.
